## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--check-runner` (branch `phase/check-runner`). Code writes only under this worktree. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts` for store writes.

Territory: you own `skills/verify-work/SKILL.md`, `scripts/close_batch.py`, and `tests/test_verify_authority.py` (plus close_batch tests if needed). Do not rework the CLI package unless a doc path name requires it. `bin/se-workflow check` already exists from wave 2.

After the change lands, commit on the phase branch (exclude `.artifacts`). Run the verify_command.

Requirements:
R5: `skills/verify-work/SKILL.md` and `scripts/close_batch.py` (or its CLI successor) use runner-produced check-runs for `tdd`/`check`; agents write assessments, not invented pass/fail results. `tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py` stays green.

Design invariants: A check-run records what happened; an assessment records what it means. Manual criteria never go through `check`. CLI is not a second store; it only shells to adaptive-artifacts. Parent session remains the authority that invokes the CLI and writes assessments.

Decision check-run-authority: Hard authority: tdd/check check-runs only via se-workflow check; agents write assessments not pass/fail.
